text: The King is waiting for you. Please proceed at once to the royal hall.

|Sir Gilbert|
So you finally decided to grace us with your presence!
What has been keeping you so long, may I ask? I don't suppose you realize how rude it is to keep the King waiting?
I'd love to stay and chat with you, old chap, but I do have a bit of important business to attend to.
Perhaps we could talk after my audience with the King?
Hmph, don't trifle me with your arrogance. Your moment here won't last long, sailor man, so enjoy it while it lasts.
Hurry up! Quickly!

|Henry the VIII|
Ah, you made it. I called you here today because there is something I must ask of you.
Anything, your majesty.
Very good. I'd like you to take command of a warship.
A warship...? Did you say a warship!?
That's correct. As you know, there is a powerful nation that threatens our mighty land of England.
Would you be referring to Spain?
Exactly. Using their newfound wealth from the New World, they are trying to conquer all of Europe.
As the King of England, I cannot sit by idly and allow this to occur. Therefore, we need to make a strong war fleet.
I would like you to accept a position as Head of the Royal Navy.
To that end, I want you to go out to sea and gain experience.
It would be an honor. I respectfully accept.
I now present you with weapons and a letter of marque.
Don't forget to equip yourself with the weapons.
With the letter of marque, all your actions will be sanctioned by the throne. Do not abuse this power!
As of today, you are working for the King of England, with a royal rank to boot.
From this day forth, you will be known as a page of King Henry the VIII.
I respectfully accept your generous offer.
You'll need gold to get prepared - ask for as much as you like. Sir Gilbert will take care of all the arrangements.
I'm counting on you, $n.
You don't need to worry about a thing, your majesty.
$s, Sir Gilbert is waiting for you.
I see.
Your ship, more ship than you deserve I might add, is at the harbor. There is also a sailor waiting to meet you there.
Do you have any questions?
I'd like you to get my money ready.
A fellow as smart as you imagine yourself to be... 300 gold pieces ought to be more than adequate.
What do you want me to do with only 300 gold pieces?! His majesty said that I should take as much as I think I need!
Stop complaining! This is more than enough!
Here, take it, you greedy scoundrel!
Since his majesty is counting on your ability, I do hope you will get us some good results.
Hurry up and go to the shipyard and the dock.
Do try to remember you are representing England! Don't embarrass us! Though, (sigh) I suppose that may be too much to hope for!
His majesty is out right now, and will not be able to meet with you.
Hello, old chap, I'd like a glass of whiskey.
Thanks, I needed that.

|The Pub Owner|
Glad you enjoyed it, $n. Now about your tab...
You know, no matter how much of your whiskey I drink, I never tire of it.
It's an honor to receive such compliments from a customer with such refined taste.
Ahhh... my friend, flattery will get you many things in life, but unfortunately no gold from me today!
Oh, it's you. The (ha!) Commodore.
Well, let's get this party started, shall we?
Hey! Did you guys hear that? This guy wants us to throw him a party!
Hmph, I think you're confused, pal. Why would I want to work for you?
Well then, let me help you make up your mind.
Say, you're pretty tough!
You're not too shabby yourself!
My name's Matthew. I guess I should call you Commodore now.
Since you've accepted that fact, how about working for me?
Why, sure. I've never met a fellow as gutsy as you. Let's sit down and have something to drink.
Well, maybe later.
Hmph, you're not that tough. But since you didn't run out of here like a scared pup, you just might be worth my time.
(pant) Oh really? (pant)
Before you, I've challenged almost every man that's come in here sayin' he's a commodore.
But you're the first to fight with me man to man.
(pant) So?
So I figure I might accept you as commodore. Only, when we fight those Spanish dogs, fight a little harder, will ya?
You're not too bad.
Same to you.
My name's Matthew... Commodore.
Hmmm, now that you've accepted me as commodore, I suppose you should be my first mate. What do you say?
I like the sound of that!
Sir $s. A strange man was just here and he told me that if I saw you I was to tell you to report to the palace.
That was probably Sir Gilbert. Even so, I wonder what he wants with me?
This is a Guild for mariners. As long as you have a ship, I'll gladly put you to work.
Sir, if you want to pick up your ship, you should go to the shipyard.

|Sailor Matthew Roy|
So are you the noble they told me was lookin' to hire a mate like myself?
And you, you're the sailor Sir Gilbert told me about?!
Oh ho, don't think I'm good enough for you, eh?
Then come on down to the pub. I'll give you quite a welcome party! Heh!
Matthew is waiting for you at the pub.
You'll have to excuse me. There is some pressing work for me at the palace. Please come by later.
I've come to pick up my ship.
Aye... Sir $s right? I've been wondering when ye'd come by.
This may be forward of me, but what is a ship as nice as this going to be used for?
If I told you I was going to use it to fight the Spanish, what would you think?
Ye must be joking! I'd rather hear that ye're going to use it for trade!
Oh, I've painted the ship's name. 'Idiot' - just as ye requested. But are ye sure ye want to use such a name?
Blast that Gilbert... Well, we'll just see who has the last laugh!
Idiot
Your ship will be waiting at the docks.
Commodore! I don't mind casting off, but where are we headed?
Ah, I was just thinking about that myself.
Why don't we do a little spying on the enemy?
That's a good idea. Alright then, let's set a course for Seville. We should head South - Southwest.
If Seville is where you want to go, leave everything to me. It's easy if you use the Auto Sail command!
What's this? Are you closed today?!
No, no... We're open, there just aren't any customers.
And why is that?
The launching ceremony for the newest vessel in the Spanish Fleet is taking place down at the docks.
The whole town went to catch a glimpse. It's like a grand fiesta down there!
This newest ship... is it all that impressive?
Aye, given today's technology, I don't think you'll find a better ship anywhere.
Have you already gone to see it?
No, no. Not yet.
I'm sure if I saw it, I'd want to sail it.
Have you already gone to see it?
Aye, it's quite a ship, my friend.
This means Spain needn't worry about peace anymore.
Hey, do you know anything about a group of crazy sailors?
Aye, they've headed off toward the harbor.
There you are, Matthew.
Commodore! I've been waiting.
Well, you certainly didn't waste any time getting a drink, did you?
It's been a long time since I had the chance to drink with landlubbers.
Don't hold back there, Commodore, I know you'll enjoy it, too!
... One hour later...
Boy, am I feeling great! Commodore, I wanted to ask you why a man like you is sailing on such a beat up ship?
Well, I don't think Sir Gilbert likes me too much.
As far as he's concerned, I'm just scheming to win favor with the King.
Why, that weasel Gilbert! I should have known. He looked like a double-crossing dog when I first laid eyes on him. Oh, Waiter, another bottle over here!
Matthew, haven't you had enough?
... a little while later...
Ahhhhhh! That was the best wine in Europe!
I can't believe you emptied that bottle!! I'm surprised you haven't passed out!
Maybe I will! Hic! Oh, the room is spinning. Hic! There's no way I can tend to the ship. I'll have to round up some more hearties.
But, but, Matthew...
Is there anyone who wants to sail with Commodore $s here?
Aye!
Speak up! I'll ask once more!
Hear hear!
Matthew, I appreciate your enthusiasm, but we'll never fit a crew of this size on that small ship.
Then get your hands on a bigger ship.
Now really, Matthew. With this many men, why, we'd need a galleon!
Well then, we'll just have to get our hands on that new Spanish beauty, won't we?
The Newest Galleon?
Didn't you see that ship at the launching ceremony? It's incredible!
If we had that, the pirates wouldn't dare come near us.
What? Didn't you see the vessel waiting in the harbor? It's an incredible warship!
If we had that ship, we could sink pirates with one shot!
Hmmm, 't would be rather ironic, using a Spanish ship to beat the Spanish...
Exactly! Not bad, eh?
Ah, it's a grand idea, but I don't see how we could possibly pull it off.
Just leave that to me. I don't want you to think I'm a good-for-nothing that just drinks all day. Come on men! Follow me!
Yay!
Wait! Where are you going?
Have you seen my buddies?
Sir, everyone's gone to the harbor.
It's pretty rowdy. Is there something special going on?
The launching ceremony of the newest galleon of the 'Invincible' Spanish Fleet has just begun!
Hey, why don't we go, too?
Hmm, it's pretty rowdy out there. I guess the launching ceremony has started.
I've heard about the 70 gun galleon, and that's one ship I'd like to get my hands on someday.
The newest Spanish Galleon is coming into the harbor.
Matthew! You gluttonous fool! Where are you?
There's still some time before morning. Why don't we catch some sleep at the inn?
Let's take a look around the town first.
It doesn't look like the newest Spanish galleon has been to the harbor yet.
When you see it up close, it is truly an incredible ship.
Hmm. Matthew's not at the harbor. He must be at the pub again.
Even the sun has gone to bed. Let's leave the search until tomorrow.
Commodore, look at this.
Where'd this ship come from?
Whether it's drinking or ship stealing, when I get serious, there's nothing and no one who can stop me.
The new Spanish galleon... Weren't there guards all around?
We told them that some female naval officer stole a ship. Most everyone went off somewhere to chase her, and then we just tied up the rest of the men and put them in the cargo bay.
But even I can't believe they fell for that story so easily. If any ship was going to be stolen, it would have been this baby.
So I guess you're not just some freeloading drunk after all. Nice job, Matthew.
Everyone aboard!
OK, let's get her out of the harbor quickly!
Fools
I'm just on my way to the launching ceremony. Would you care to join me?
Did you see the ceremony? It was fabulous!
Ah, I've really got to hand it to the Spanish; their shipbuilding is remarkable.
Hey, have you seen a dark-haired Englishman around? He was probably a little tipsy.
No, I haven't.
Commodore, weren't we going to gather information on the enemy?
(Yawn) Gu' Morning, Commodore.
Ah, Matthew, you finally woke up.
Oh, my head is killing me... Wait, where are we?
Ha, nice view from up here, isn't it?
Commodore, what in the world brought us to such a high ship?!
Ha, ha, ha. You don't remember at all, do you, Matthew. You stole this ship!  And you'll be happy to hear, that we just found the 10,000 gold pieces in the captain's cabin!
Commodore, I do have one thing I'm a little worried about...
What is it, Matthew?
The whole time we've been sailing, right up to this port, there's been a ship tailing us. I doubt that it's just a merchant ship.
I hadn't noticed that, but couldn't it be just a simple coincidence?
That's what I thought at first. But when it saw that we were going to port here, it pulled back rather quickly.
Somebody tailing us... If that's so, it's probably friends of the Spanish.
I think we should increase the strength of our equipment as much as possible. Just in case.
Commodore, it's the Spanish alright. They must want their ship back.
Even they have some honor to uphold. They've come to sink us I bet.
I can't believe they're this upset! After all, we only stole one ship!
Everyone to your posts! We're going to take on the Spanish!
Commodore, let's have a drink!
Commodore, I'm thirsty. Aren't you? Shall we be off to the pub?
Are you craving a drink again? I'm amazed you're not brain dead yet!
Commodore, those men were quite the fools!
You're right. Exactly like you, scared of the ghost in the sack.
I'll just pretend I didn't hear that.
Commodore, my throat is feeling a little dry.
Alright! Time to go to the pub!
We're late, Commodore. No one will be waiting for us at the pub anymore.
You're right. But we should stop by there anyway.
Commodore, are we going to forget about our meeting?
Oh, we'd better hurry to the pub...
Commodore, is something wrong? Let's go.
Just a moment...
... I hear something. It sounds like it's coming from the storage area.
Commodore, don't say things like that. I hate those kinds of things.
There's something intriguing about that noise. Let's just check it out.
(sigh) Just as curious as ever.
Matthew, come here. That big sack over there is moving!
Ahhhhh, it's a ghost!
Calm down, Matthew. It looks like there's someone or something in the sack.
Don't have a heart attack. I'm going to open it now.
What's this... there's two people tied up here.
It looks like they're sailors.
Save us! Help us!
Hey you loafing bums! Hurry up and untie us.
Why you no good, ungrateful.. we were going to help you... Why don't we just keep you in that sack!

|Female Pirate Catalina|
What are you fellows doing there?!
Why, who are you?
Those two are my shipmates. You work for Joao, don't you?
Draw your sword. I challenge you to a duel.
Wait a minute. You've got us confused with somebody else.
We were just passing by. Just ask your friends here.
Is that true, Emilio?

|Emilio|
Y..Yes.

|Andreas|
Commodore, I'm ashamed of myself.
Who did this to you? Was it Joao?
To be honest with you, it wasn't. We were tied up by his first mate Rocco.
He was too strong for us.
Oh, now I remember! I've heard stories about some old man called 'Monster Rocco'.
Why didn't you tell us this earlier?
What does it matter? I still wouldn't have known what he looked like.
Stop arguing, and stand up, mates. It's too late now. It wouldn't do us any good to go off chasing him.
My name is Catalina Erantzo. Please forgive my previous actions, I'm a little jumpy lately.
Say nothing of it. My name is $n $s. I'm commander of a fleet from England.
So who is this Joao character? What's the story with him? I'd like to hear about it over a cup of tea.
Hmm... well, maybe. I'll meet you at the pub in about two hours.
That girl's still not here.
Why don't we go kill some time somewhere?
We're pretty late.
She's probably not waiting anymore.
Pardon me, old chap, but has a strong-willed beautiful woman been here recently?
Yes, she was here with a companion for about two hours, but they've left.
Too bad. It just wasn't written in the stars.
It doesn't look like they've come yet.
It sure looks like she was chasing after that guy Joao.
Commodore, if I remember correctly, that Joao fellow is a member of the Franco family, the most powerful family in Portugal.
The Franco Family... I heard that Leon Franco was a superb mariner. Catalina's in a bad spot, if he's her enemy.
Sorry to keep you waiting.
Not at all. We just got here. So, what's the story with this Joao fellow?
He escaped from me, but someday I'll catch him. And when I do, he'll be sorry.
Miss Erantzo...
Please, call me Catalina.
Well then, Catalina, why are you chasing this fellow?
Revenge!
Revenge?
His family is responsible for a most cowardly and dastardly plot, that resulted in the loss of my brother and fiance.
So, I will avenge their defeat. No matter what I have to do, I won't rest until every last member of the Franco family has suffered the consequences of their wretched act.
That's a pretty extraordinary story. However, I don't think that anyone from the noble house of Franco would do such a thing.
Think what you will, but there is just one truth for me.
I've given up my homeland to avenge the loss of my brother and fiance. There's no turning back now.
Plus, I have mates who have sworn their loyalty to me. Even now they wait at the ship for my return.
I think I've said too much to you already. If you'll excuse me..
Catalina..
What?
What will you do after you get your revenge?
I... I can't think about that now. Farewell. Perhaps we'll meet again...
Holy Cow! I wouldn't want her for my wife.
If you were to be the groom, I'm sure she would refuse.
Sir, have you heard? They say that there are ghosts around the trader's place.
My my, you seem the strong type. Would you go and have a look for me?
Commodore, you're pretty good with the ladies there.
Hey wait.. no..I didn't.. I mean I wasn't..
Commodore, I'm so thirsty! Isn't it time?
Hmph, time for your bottle, I suppose. OK, we'll stop by the pub.
Please Commodore, I feel faint with thirst.
OK. We'll stop by the pub.
Commodore, do you plan to give them the slip?
Yes, we'd better hurry up if we want to make it to the pub.
Commodore, if you go to sleep now, you'll be breaking your promise to meet that pretty woman.
OK, OK. I get the picture.
Commodore, I'm serious. It's time.
(Sigh) Time to drink.
Commodore, this is torture. I'm starting to hallucinate - are those empty bottles and glasses following you, too?
OK, we'll stop by the pub.
Commodore, do you plan to give them the slip?
That's right, if we don't hurry up and get to the pub.
Commodore, it's about that woman from a little while ago...
Hmm, it looks like she's got something she's not telling us.
Commodore, maybe I'm imagining this, but I think I hear the clank of a bottle against a glass.
Ah, I guess it's time to drink again.
Commodore, I can't wait any longer.
OK, we'll stop by the pub.
Commodore, are you planning to slip past them?
We'd better hurry up if we're going to make the pub.
Oh ho. I run the best pub in town! Don't you all agree?
Well then, old pal, give me some of your best Scotch.
I'll take that, too - make it a double.
Say Commodore, I'm bored. Don't you have any exciting stories?

|Pietro Conti|
Why, I have some exciting stories.
Who in the blazes are you?
I am Pietro Conti, adventurer. I'm pretty famous for my treasure hunts and adventures.
You sound like a liar to me!
You know you really don't need to be so rude.
And what does this grave robber want with me?
Grave robber?! That's cruel. You fellows said you were looking for an interesting story, that's why I came over here.
How about buying my story? Actually, I'm in a bit of a fix. You see I owe a bit of money to that Turkish fellow over there.
He's a heartless merchant, no blood, no tears, the worst kind. So you can see my predicament.
Commodore, what are you going to do?
That depends on how much he wants.
Listen. Here's the situation. I need a loan. I owe that guy 10,000 gold pieces. Are you going to pay?
I'm sorry but I don't have that kind of money with me now.
You've got no sense of adventure. Oh well, I guess I'll just tell my story to Joao, then. Sorry to bother you.
He's gone. Odd fellow, wasn't he?
I wouldn't trust you as far as I can throw you. Sorry, but why don't you try somewhere else?
What?! Why you're mighty suspicious. Oh well, I'll just have to tell my story to Joao. Sorry to bother you.
He's gone. Odd fellow wasn't he?
Alright, we'll listen to your story. Go ahead.
That's a sport. Now, Listen up.
There's a Spanish frigate headed for Seville. It's absolutely loaded to the brim with gold from the New World.
And?
I'll continue once I get some money.

Pay
Bargain
Don't Pay
Ah, we'll pay.
The frigate full of gold is finally leaving Veracruz. A sailor called $r04 $r03 is at the helm.
That's the end of my story.
He's gone. Odd fellow, wasn't he?
10,000 gold pieces is a bit expensive for a story like that. We'll pay half that.
Hmph, well alright. A seaman called $r04 $r03 is at the helm. That's the end of my story.
He's gone. Odd fellow, wasn't he?
We're not going to pay money for nonsense like that.
Hmph, you cheapster. I'm going to spread the word at harbors all over that you're just a chintzy sailor.
He's gone. Odd fellow, wasn't he?
Chintzy
Say, aren't you the famous Sir $s? Henry the VIII is looking for you. You'd better hurry to the palace in London at once.
Bring honor to the homeland.
The King is waiting for you. Please go at once to the royal hall.
Well, if it's not the scourge of England. So where have you been wasting your time?
You've no right to talk to me like that.
Oh, why not? Just because you've advanced in the royal lineup doesn't mean you're worthy of my respect.
What a bitter fellow.
Oh, ho, you made it. I've been waiting.
What is this sudden task, your majesty?
Hmm, yes.. Do you remember that I asked you, as Head of the Royal navy, to destroy the Spanish Fleet?
Of course, your majesty. It is engraved deep in my heart.
And also that in order to prepare yourself for that task, that I wanted you to head out to sea and sharpen your skills?
It is as you say.
Well, a few days ago our royal navy faced the Spanish Fleet, and unfortunately, we lost nearly half our ships.
Furthermore, it looks like they're preparing for a massive offensive. They are calling in all of their ships.
If things don't change, it's just a matter of time before our navy is completely wiped out by the Spanish.
And that would be a dark day in the history of our beloved England.
So I want you to accept this task, though I know it is difficult, and very likely impossible.
Please tell me what you want me to do.
I want you to take your men and destroy the Spanish Fleet.
With what's left of our fleet, defending the homeland is about all we're capable of.. if even that.
Yours are the strongest forces this nation has. You're our only hope!
I understand sire. Even if it means my life, I will destroy the Spanish Fleet!
I can't thank you enough...
I have made several requests of you, but this one must take precedence over all others. Please keep that in mind.
Yes sire. Then I'll be off to fight the Spaniards.
Welcome Master $s. Henry VIII has been waiting anxiously for your arrival.
Do you have any information on the Spanish Fleet?
Here you are Master $s..some information on their 'Invincible Fleet'.
The very existence of our homeland is riding on this battle. All I desire is to win and bring peace to the seas.
Peace throughout the world? I wouldn't mind that either.
Alright then. Why don't I give you some new information. They're having some financial trouble back home. It looks like they're trying to suppress the piracy that robs them of their New World wealth.
In particular, they're after a female pirate named Catalina.
Catalina.. now that's a name that brings back memories.
The Spanish Fleet uses a triangular fighting strategy, surrounding their enemy on three sides.
According to our latest information, the fleet is docked for supplies at these three ports: Nantes, Bordeaux, and Seville.
It is said that they're all going to meet somewhere near the South American mainland.
The Commander of Forces is a man named Ezequiel, a proud general with an impressive battle record.
If you are surrounded by the three fleets, there's no escape.
Commodore, what should we do? To rush headlong into the Spanish fleet would be foolhardy.
I'd like to help Catalina, but I think this time it's better to think things out carefully.
No, we're going to attack.
You can't be serious... you would go that far just to help that woman?!
No Matthew, you don't understand. It has nothing to do with her. Right now, we're more powerful than they are.
But, that triangular strategy...
I know that if we were surrounded by their 3 fleets, we wouldn't stand a chance. But their little net trap is not yet complete.
And I don't plan to sit around waiting for them to finish it. We're going to destroy each fleet one by one, before they can converge.
What guts... OK, then what fleet are we going to start with?
Why, the one closest to us of course!
Welcome Master $s. Henry the VIII has been waiting anxiously for your arrival.
The 'Invincible' Spanish Fleet? You should ask the people in the Guild.
Commodore, let's get to Nantes Harbor and crush that Spanish fleet.
Commodore, while we were fighting, the other ships sailed off somewhere.
I know. They sailed off to the west. I wonder if they've been ordered not to fight before the convergence?
We know they're headed for the South American mainland, let's follow them!
Have you seen the Spanish Fleet any where in this vicinity?
The Spanish Fleet? After loading up with supplies at several harbors, they left in the direction of the Amazon river.
But there was one division that came late. They might still be in Santo Domingo.
The Amazon? They're headed in a pretty strange direction.
Commodore, let's go sink that lousy Spanish fleet docked in Santo Domingo harbor.
Commodore, while we were fighting, the other ships sailed off somewhere.
I can't fathom what their aim could be... Why don't they even try to fight with us?
What should we do?
There's bound to be something in the area around the Amazon. Let's go check it out.
Commodore, let's go check out the Amazon River area.
This is strange... It looks like there was just a big battle here... there's the remains of a warship...
Commodore, there's a fleet approaching us. Oh! It's Catalina!
So we meet again, $n.
I must say I'm surprised to be meeting you here, of all places. Do you think you could wait a little while? I've got some unfinished business to take care of.
Wait a minute. I don't have any right to make such a request, but... I don't want you to fight Ezequiel right now.
I'm sorry, but we can't do that. You see, just like you are after Joao, we have been chasing Ezequiel.
And furthermore, isn't Ezequiel supposed to be one of your enemies?
You're right about that, but right now things are different.
I don't understand.
Ezequiel, Joao, and I have all joined forces to destroy a common foe - the Marquis Martinez of Portugal.
He was an evil man with plans to conquer the world. He was the one who really destroyed my brother and fiance.
I was able to avenge their loss with the help of Joao and Ezequiel. But their fleets are all badly damaged.
(Yes! This should be an easy victory!)
If you are truly an honorable commodore, you won't be satisfied with such a cheap victory.
(What is she talking about?)
Matthew, we're pulling back!
Whaat?!
Didn't you hear me? I said we're pulling back!
OK, OK, I heard you. (I can't believe he fell for her little spiel!)
Did you say something?!
No, nothing, Commodore.
I don't believe it! What a big bully! You really like to beat up on weaker people don't you?! So go ahead, do what you want!
But as a punishment, all your abilities will be reduced.
Commodore, with our abilities this low, we'll never make it back to London. It doesn't look like we'll ever see the ending, so why don't we just restart the game?
$n, please don't break your promise to me.
Hm, I figured you would go to the pub. My favorite place!
You really love to drink, don't you?
Yup. Wow, the pub is pretty crowded tonight. I wonder if there's some ship stopping by in the harbor?
Excuse me, but may I sit here?
Feel free.
Thank you. I'm sorry about this, but I'm supposed to meet someone here.
Don't worry about it.
It looks like you two gentlemen are sailors. Englishmen?
Yes, but we had some business in the area. And you?
I'm from Seville. I'm also here on business. I've still some important things to attend to.
But let's forget work. Since you let me sit down here, will you let me buy you a drink?
That'd be nice of you, but nicer if you bought me two, at least. Waiter! Bring us our drinks!
Matthew! That's no way to talk to a stranger, especially one so distinguished.
Please forgive my companion for his impoliteness.
No, no, don't think twice about it. I've spent quite a bit of my life at sea, I know what seafaring men are like.
Waiter, please bring us some rum, if you please.
Right away, sir.
Thank you very much.
Ha, ha, ha, ha, ha! This rum is really good!
Matthew! Remember you're in the British Royal Navy. Remember to be courteous!
Did you say British Navy? Excuse me, but you two...
Forgive me for waiting so long to introduce myself. I'm Ezequiel, Commander of the Spanish Fleet.
You..you are Commander Ezequiel?
I am $n $s, leader of a navy fleet under King Henry the VIII's orders.
That.. that means you were the head of that fleet in South America?
Just one question. Why didn't you attack us then?
Our supplies were exhausted. It would have been easy for you to finish us off.
The answer is simple - honor.
Ah.
Only a coward would have attacked you then, when you were weak. I did not want to stain my name.
But more than that, I wanted to fight, face to face, with you, the famous naval commander of Spain.
Hmm, it seems that you are quite a capable commodore yourself.
